title: [GDN][KDA] ReplaySSM buffered output-only decode for Linear Attention
body_opening:
## Motivation

To address https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/28511.

The GDN (Gated DeltaNet) decode kernel reads the full recurrent state `S [HV, V, K]` from HBM **and writes it back every decode step**. On the H20‑3e this packed decode is **70–79% memory-bandwidth-bound at batch ≥ 64** — the per-step state read+write traffic dominates.

ReplaySSM (Dao AI Lab, https://dao-lab.ai/blog/2026/replayssm/) removes the per-step state write: keep a small per-slot ring buffer of the last `L` steps' `(d, k, g)`, read the output via the history route, and flush the full state only every `L` steps. Per-step state traffic drops from read+write ( ~`8dn` ) to read-only ( ~`4dn` ) → roughly

title: [1/4][JIT] Vendor FlashMLA upstream files for the DSV4 MXFP4 decode kernel
body_opening:
## Motivation

Part 1/4 of splitting up #32741 (MXFP4 KV cache decode for DeepSeek V4 on Hopper) into reviewable pieces, per the review request. This PR only vendors upstream files; the consuming kernel lands in part 3.

## Modifications

- Add `python/sglang/kernels/jit/csrc/deepseek_v4/mxfp4_dsv4_decode_sm90/` containing the FlashMLA scheduler/combine kernels and `kerutils` support headers, vendored unchanged from FlashMLA upstream @ `05e26647` (`combine.cuh`, `defines.h`, `flashmla_utils.h`, `params.h`, `utils.h`, `kerutils/**`). Kerutils includes were converted to relative paths during vendoring.
- Nothing references these files yet, so there is no behavior change.

No
